interpreterResult.requirementSummary: When the user selects a condenser type of Air Cooled (AC) or Evaporative Cooled (EC), the system must display the corresponding input fields, capture the entered parameters (including design ambient, ASHRAE summer design, tube/fin materials and sizes for AC, and bank ID, copies, EC model, wet bulb temperature for EC), record these parameters, and upon processing output a condenser and circuit‑level configuration ready for ECS calculation. For AC condensers, selecting Condenser Passes must present options AutoOdd, AutoEven, and numeric values 2 through 41 in increments of 1, and selecting Roof Type must present dark and light roof options with and without parapet/shrouding.
businessRules: When the user selects the Condenser Type "AC" or "EC", the system shall display the corresponding input fields.
Design Ambient shall default to 95°F (or equivalent in °C) and be echoed in output 3.7.
Condenser Tube Material shall default to Copper.
Condenser Fin Material shall default to Aluminum.
Condenser Tube Size shall default to "3/8, 3/8 w/ 1" spacing".
Condenser Fin Type shall default to Corrugated.
Given AC/EC condenser parameters and per‑circuit cooling configurations, when processed, the system shall output condenser and circuit‑level configuration ready for ECS calculation.
Given the user is configuring an AC condenser, when they enter ambient design conditions and coil geometry, the system shall record the condenser parameters.
Given the user is configuring an EC condenser, when they enter the EC model and wet bulb temperature, the system shall record the EC condenser parameters.
Given the user configures an AC condenser, when they select Condenser Passes, the system shall display the options AutoOdd, AutoEven, and numeric values 2 through 41 in increments of 1.
Given the user configures an AC condenser, when they select Roof Type, the system shall display the specified dark and light roof type options with and without parapet/shrouding.
developerConsiderations: Implement conditional UI logic to show AC‑specific fields when Condenser Type = AC and EC‑specific fields when Condenser Type = EC.
Provide default values for Design Ambient, Condenser Tube Material, Fin Material, Tube Size, and Fin Type as specified.
Populate the Condenser Passes selector with the exact option list: AutoOdd, AutoEven, and integers 2‑41.
Populate the Roof Type selector with dark and light options, each having variants with and without parapet/shrouding.
Capture and store all user‑entered values for later ECS calculation processing.
Ensure numeric inputs accept both °F and °C units where applicable.
ambiguities: The exact set of roof type option labels (beyond "dark" and "light") and how parapet/shrouding is represented is not defined.
The catalog of valid EC Model values is referenced but not listed.
Units for Design Ambient default are given as 95°F; conversion to °C is implied but not specified.
The acceptable range or validation rules for ASHRAE Summer Design, Copies of this Bank, and Wet Bulb Temperature are not provided.
The format and content of the output "condenser and circuit‑level configuration" for ECS calculation are unspecified.
The definition of "coil geometry" required for AC condenser recording is not detailed.

reviewResult.rationale: The interpreter identified several ambiguities that remain unresolved, each requiring clarification from the ticket owner before a reliable implementation can be produced. These open ambiguities block a PASS status.
